description: This file defines the stable C API extensions for Torch, providing version-aware functions and data structures to support backward and forward compatibility when calling ATen operations via the dispatcher. It includes function declarations for dispatching, list management, device parsing, parallel utilities, tensor data access, string handling, CUDA stream management, and other utility functions.

classes.name: StableListOpaque
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a list of stable values, used with handle-based management in the API.

classes.name: StringOpaque
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a string handle for string management in the API.

methods.name: torch_call_dispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches a call to a Torch operator by name and overload, with a stack of inputs, taking into account extension build version for compatibility.

methods.name: torch_library_impl
methods.description: Version-aware implementation registration for Torch libraries, allowing for extension build version parameter.

methods.name: torch_new_list_reserve_size
methods.description: Creates a new list with reserved size, returning a handle.

methods.name: torch_list_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the list referenced by the handle.

methods.name: torch_list_get_item
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the list at the specified index.

methods.name: torch_list_set_item
methods.description: Sets an item in the list at the specified index.

methods.name: torch_list_push_back
methods.description: Appends an item to the list.

methods.name: torch_delete_list
methods.description: Deletes the list, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: torch_parse_device_string
methods.description: Parses a device string and returns device type and index.

methods.name: torch_parallel_for
methods.description: Runs a parallel for loop with specified begin and end indices and grain size.

methods.name: torch_get_thread_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of the current thread in a parallel region.

methods.name: torch_get_num_threads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads available in the parallel backend.

methods.name: torch_get_mutable_data_ptr
methods.description: Provides a mutable pointer to tensor data.

methods.name: torch_get_const_data_ptr
methods.description: Provides a const pointer to tensor data.

methods.name: torch_new_string_handle
methods.description: Creates a new string handle from data and length.

methods.name: torch_delete_string
methods.description: Deletes a string handle.

methods.name: torch_string_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string.

methods.name: torch_string_c_str
methods.description: Returns a C string pointer to the string data.

methods.name: torch_get_current_cuda_blas_handle
methods.description: Retrieves the current CUDA BLAS handle.

methods.name: torch_set_current_cuda_stream
methods.description: Sets the current CUDA stream for a device.

methods.name: torch_get_cuda_stream_from_pool
methods.description: Obtains a CUDA stream from the pool, with optional priority.

methods.name: torch_cuda_stream_synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified CUDA stream.

methods.name: torch_c10_cuda_check_msg
methods.description: Checks CUDA implementation and captures error message without throwing.

methods.name: torch_c10_cuda_free_error_msg
methods.description: Frees error message allocated during CUDA checks.

methods.name: torch_set_requires_grad
methods.description: Sets the requires_grad flag for a tensor.

ctags.name: ParallelFunc
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*ParallelFunc)(int64_t begin, int64_t end, void* ctx);$/
